profiles.description: Broad selected-event Sysmon telemetry with known-good noise exclusions for process, network, file, registry, DNS, WMI, and tampering events.
profiles.warning: Applying this profile changes the local Sysmon configuration and may increase event volume.

profiles.description: Lower-volume Sysmon telemetry focused on core IR process, network, DNS, persistence, and sensitive-access events.
profiles.warning: Applying this profile changes the local Sysmon configuration and can omit noisier diagnostic events.
